basics.name: Harris Song
basics.summary: B.S. Computer Science @ UCLA. Software Engineer at Shopify. Research in 3D Vision-Language Models and embedded ML systems.

highlights: Improving Shopify's Catalog Search (Elasticsearch-based) performance in C++
Approx. Nearest Neighbor benchmark indexing, searching 3×10⁵ queries/s for large-scale (1B+ items) catalogs
Optimizing up ten-fold (from 5×10³ to 3×10⁵ q/s), working w/ ML Pipelines, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes for deployment

work.summary: Worked on Sea Archer autonomous vessel systems
highlights: Lightweight implementation of Sea Hunter that has already circumnavigated the world
Converted server-grade Kubernetes DevOps to lightweight Docker, RHEL/Rocky 8, enabling autonomous startup/stop
Debugged Ansible Playbooks and System C++ Architecture, built on NVIDIA-like edge hardware
Developed detection and defusal software for improvised explosive devices autonomously found in the Iraq War
Used OpenCV, Python for camera-based bomb detection, unit/integration tests with hardware-in-the-loop for validation
Modernized fleet of Turtlebots to NVIDIA Edge-AI Jetson TX2, Astra Orbbec 3D to ZED RGB-D camera
Worked on lahacks.com, apply.lahacks.com, managing UX and statistics features
Built backend features supporting 6k+ applications through PostgreSQL, JWT Auth (Supabase) and Next.js (Vercel)
Improved submission workflow, 2x application count (from 3k to 6k) through UX, performance and reliability
Multi-modal CV running C on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano
Developed Linux kernel drivers and C firmware for FLIR Lepton thermal sensors
Implemented SPI/I2C protocol, UART, and boot loader (extlinux.conf, DTB) on Ubuntu 20.04/Linux Tegra
Researching 3D Vision-Language Transformer Models, developing intuition for the 3D World through co-training
Running 2k parallel simulations on NVIDIA HPC w/ Python, CUDA, PyTorch, Multi-Modal (text, 3D Voxels) architecture
State-of-the-Art model more generalizable than previous discrete architectures, accepted into NeurIPS 2025 Workshop

portfolio.description: Top 20/115 teams. Management software for sorting trash. Connected IoT to ML pipeline. Vision-based model on ~450 images for recyclables.

portfolio.name: FIRST Robotics - Team Captain and Mentor
portfolio.description: 1st in Nation (7000+ teams) twice in 2021, 2023. Built hardware-in-the-loop software for World Champs. Multi-camera fault-tolerant systems, TensorFlow ML 97% confidence vision detection.
